# bogotobogo.com

> > A comprehensive open-source learning platform covering Python, DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes, Machine Learning, and BigData with tutorials, code examples, and practical guides.

bogotobogo.com is an educational resource founded by K Hong with expertise from Seoul National University, offering in-depth tutorials across programming languages, DevOps tools, cloud technologies, and data science. The site emphasizes practical, hands-on learning with real-world applications in containerization, microservices, and modern software development.

## Key Topics

- Python
- Docker
- Kubernetes
- DevOps
- Machine Learning
- BigData
- Java
- Linux
- Continuous Integration
- Microservices
- OpenCV
- C++
- Web Development
- Cloud Computing
- Open Source

## Core Programming Languages

- [Python Tutorial: Home - 2024](https://bogotobogo.com/python/pytut.php): Python tutorial hub covering OpenCV, NumPy, Matplotlib, image processing
- [C++ Tutorial Front Page - 2020](https://bogotobogo.com/cplusplus/cpptut.php): C++ tutorial covering fundamentals, algorithms, data structures, STL
- [Java Tutorial 2020](https://bogotobogo.com/Java/tutorials/on_java.php): Java tutorial covering DevOps, Maven, Jenkins, continuous integration
- [GoLang Tutorial - Closures and Anonymous Functions - 2020](https://bogotobogo.com/GoLang/GoLang_Closures_Anonymous_Functions.php): GoLang tutorial on closures and anonymous functions with code examples

## DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure

- [DevOps (Development & Operations) - 2023](https://bogotobogo.com/DevOps/DevOps_Jenkins_Chef_Puppet_Graphite_Logstash.php): DevOps overview covering CI/CD, containers, deployment automation, culture
- [Docker : From a monolithic app to micro services on GCP Kubernetes - 2020](https://bogotobogo.com/DevOps/Docker/Docker-from-Monolithic-to-Micro-services-GCP-Kubernetes.php): Docker and Kubernetes tutorial on microservices migration on GCP
- [Hadoop 2.6 - Installing on Ubuntu 14.04 (Single-Node Cluster) - 2020](https://bogotobogo.com/Hadoop/BigData_hadoop_Install_on_ubuntu_single_node_cluster.php): Hadoop 2.6 installation guide for Ubuntu 14.04 single-node cluster setup
- [Linux Tips 1 - 2021](https://bogotobogo.com/Linux/linux_tips1.php): Linux shell programming tips for DevOps and system administration

## Machine Learning & Data Science

- [Artificial Neural Network (ANN) - Introduction - 2020](https://bogotobogo.com/python/scikit-learn/Artificial-Neural-Network-ANN-1-Introduction.php): Introduction to Artificial Neural Networks using scikit-learn in Python

## Web Development & Frameworks

- [AngularJS Tutorial: Introduction - 2020](https://bogotobogo.com/AngularJS/AngularJS_Introduction.php): AngularJS framework introduction covering data binding and MVC patterns
- [Django: Forums on a Shared Host - 2020](https://bogotobogo.com/python/Django/Python_Django_Forums_Shared_Host.php): Django 1.8 forum application tutorial for shared hosting deployment
- [Ruby On Rails Tutorial: Introduction - 2020](https://bogotobogo.com/RubyOnRails/RubyOnRails.php): Ruby on Rails framework introduction covering gems, rake, and patterns
- [HTML5 Tutorial - 0. Introduction - 2017](https://bogotobogo.com/HTML5/HTML5_Tutorial.php): HTML5 introduction covering markup language and web development basics

## Algorithms & Data Structures

- [Algorithms & Data Structures - 2020](https://bogotobogo.com/Algorithms/algorithms.php): Algorithms and data structures reference covering complexity, trees, hashing

## Multimedia & Specialized Tools

- [Qt5 Tutorial Creating QtQuick2 QML Application Animation A - 2016](https://bogotobogo.com/Qt/Qt5_Creating_QtQuick2_QML_Application_Animation_A.php): Qt5 QML animation tutorial using QtQuick2 and Qt Creator IDE
- [FFmpeg : concatinating slideshow files - 2020](https://bogotobogo.com/FFMpeg/ffmpeg_fade_in_fade_out_transitions_effects_filters_slideshow_concat.php): FFmpeg tutorial on video transitions, filters, and slideshow concatenation
- [Matlab Tutorial : Manipulating Audio I - 2020](https://bogotobogo.com/Matlab/Matlab_Tutorial_Manipulating_Audio_I_Reverse_Delay_Tone_Control_Changing_Speed_Removing_Vocals.php): Matlab audio manipulation tutorial covering signal processing and effects

- [Open Source: 2024 - Python/Docker/Kubernetes/DevOps/BigData/Machine Learning/](https://bogotobogo.com/index.php): Homepage covering Python, Docker, Kubernetes, DevOps, BigData, ML tutorials
